description: Grounded in Meng et al., 'Uncovering Vulnerabilities of LLM-Assisted Cyber Threat Intelligence' (arXiv:2509.23573v3, Feb 2026). Classifies a CTI claim against the paper's three failure modes — spurious correlation, contradictory knowledge, constrained generalization — using intel.db grounding plus DeepSeek synthesis. Returns a reliability score, verdict, corroborating/contradicting evidence, and confidence. Price: $0.20 USDC per call via x402 on Base mainnet. An unpaid call returns an x402 PaymentRequired challenge; retry the identical call with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"].

actor.description: Optional actor name to ground the claim against intel.db, e.g. SANDWORM.

claim.description: The CTI claim to assess, e.g. an actor-targeting, attribution, or TTP claim.

cve_id.description: Optional CVE ID to ground the claim against intel.db.

name: getClaimReliability
title: CTI Claim Reliability Scoring
